LanguageData.WorkStudio.Settings.Intro: Reorganize the Work tab without restarting: create your own work types, move tasks into them from other types, rename, reorder and hide columns.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Settings.SaveNote: Colonist priorities are saved by work name, so you can change this setup between sessions without scrambling them. Removing the mod simply gives moved tasks their original types back.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Settings.ConfirmResetAll: Erase your whole setup? Custom types will be gone and every task will return to its original type. Export it first if you want to be able to come back to it.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Presets.Title: Saved setups
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Presets.None: No saved setup yet. The ones you export will go to:\n{0}
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Presets.ConfirmImport: Import "{0}"? Your current setup will be replaced entirely.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Presets.ConfirmOverwrite: A setup named "{0}" already exists. Overwrite it?
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Drift.Title: Work Studio — your mod list changed
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Drift.Intro: The available work has changed since the last startup. Your setup is intact: nothing was erased.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Drift.GoneTypes: Work types that are gone: {0}. The tasks you had filed under them went back to their original types.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Drift.MissingTasks: Tasks your setup still remembers but cannot find: {0}. They will fall back into place if the mod that provides them comes back.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Drift.NewTypes: New work types: {0}. They sit according to their own priority, so not necessarily where you would expect them in the order you had set.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.VisibleTip: Show the column in the Work tab. A hidden type stays active; only its column disappears.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.NoSelection: Pick a work type on the left.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.NoTasks: No tasks. The column still shows up, but no colonist will have anything to do in it.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.OrderTip: Priority within the type: {0} — drag the row to reorder
LanguageData.WorkStudio.AddHint: Click a task to bring it into "{0}".
LanguageData.WorkStudio.RenameTitle: New name for the work type
LanguageData.WorkStudio.ConfirmDelete: Delete the "{0}" type? Its tasks will return to their original types.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Field.Label: Name
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Field.PawnLabel: Name of the colonist doing it
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Field.AlwaysStartActive: Always active on a new colonist
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Field.RequireCapable: Warn when no colonist can do it
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Icons.SkillsDesc: Draws an icon before each skill name in the character tab.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Icons.WorkTypesDesc: Draws an icon at the foot of each Work tab column header.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Icons.HeaderModeUnavailable: Available once icons on Work tab columns are switched on.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Icons.HeaderBothDesc: The usual header, with the icon added at its foot. Long labels use the icon and a tooltip instead of covering other columns.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Icons.HeaderIconDesc: Narrower columns, since the name is dropped. Hovering a header still says what the column is.
LanguageData.WorkStudio.Icons.HeaderLabelDesc: The vanilla header, with no icon on it. The skill list keeps its own.
